lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately 12 visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters, each containing between 3 to 6 distinct centroids on the mid-to-posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, forming a localized grid-like pattern across the primary flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature positioned on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and shadow-depth pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-contrast, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the anterior-basal region of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small irregular indentation or notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast elongated pixel cluster (remora) attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
